name: msk_kafka
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS MSK (Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka) provisioned cluster, in which you size the brokers, provisioned within an environment and resource group.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this MSK cluster.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Cluster name. Letters, numbers, and hyphens. Cannot be changed after creation.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment in which the cluster is provisioned.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group in which the cluster is provisioned.

attributes.name: kafka_version
attributes.description: Apache Kafka version for the cluster (e.g. 3.6.0). Can be upgraded in place.

attributes.name: instance_type
attributes.description: Broker instance type (e.g. kafka.m5.large). Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: broker_volume_size_gb
attributes.description: EBS storage per broker, in GiB. Can be increased in place.

attributes.name: number_of_broker_nodes
attributes.description: Number of broker nodes. Must be a multiple of the number of broker subnets (Availability Zones); rounded up server-side. Can be increased in place.

attributes.name: subnet_ids
attributes.description: Private subnets (2-4, each in a distinct Availability Zone) to place brokers in. Leave unset to use all of the resource group's private subnets. Write-only at creation.

attributes.name: encryption
attributes.description: Encryption at rest. AwsManagedKey uses the AWS-managed MSK key; ResourceGroupKmsKey uses the resource group's KMS key; NoEncryption disables it. Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: encryption_in_transit
attributes.description: How clients connect: TLS (encrypted), TLS_PLAINTEXT (both), or PLAINTEXT (unencrypted).

attributes.name: configuration_arn
attributes.description: ARN of a saved MSK (Kafka broker) configuration to apply. Leave unset for the AWS default.

attributes.name: configuration_revision
attributes.description: Revision of the MSK configuration referenced by configuration_arn.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the scopes attached to this cluster.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type. Defaults to DirectApiCall for MSK.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Tags applied to the cluster at creation. Platform ownership tags are added automatically.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status of the cluster.

attributes.name: security_group_ids
attributes.description: Security groups attached to the cluster (assigned by the platform).

attributes.name: cluster_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the provisioned MSK cluster.

attributes.name: bootstrap_brokers
attributes.description: Plaintext bootstrap broker connection string.

attributes.name: bootstrap_brokers_tls
attributes.description: TLS bootstrap broker connection string.

attributes.name: bootstrap_brokers_sasl_scram
attributes.description: SASL/SCRAM bootstrap broker connection string.

attributes.name: bootstrap_brokers_sasl_iam
attributes.description: SASL/IAM bootstrap broker connection string.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cluster was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the cluster was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.

readyFailureStates.FAILED: the cluster entered a FAILED state during the update
